task1.title: A college café before and after redesign
task1.prompt: The plans below show a college café before it was redesigned and how it looks now.

changes: Serving area (all food & drink) changed to Hot meals
Two Staff dining rooms replaced by Take away food and Coffee bar
Salad bar added along the left interior wall
Outdoor seating added outside along the south wall
Barbecue added outside on the bottom left corner
chartDesc.overview: The café was modernized and restructured to diversify service options (adding a coffee bar, takeaway food, salad bar, barbecue, and outdoor seating) while removing the dedicated staff dining rooms.
unchanged: Main indoor area with Tables and chairs
keyFeatures: Staff dining rooms replaced by Take away food and Coffee bar
Serving area renamed/purposed to Hot meals
Addition of Salad bar, Barbecue, and Outdoor seating

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Theatres and cinemas in the digital age
task2.prompt:
Some people say that in the digital age, theatres and cinemas are no longer important as people can watch all the entertainment they want online. Others argue that theatres and cinemas are still important both economically and culturally.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
